speaker: gauge
text: This giant ball hangs high inside a skyscraper. It just swings. I'll cut it out.

speaker: gauge
text: So make the tower perfectly stiff.

speaker: fitz
text: Tall towers bend in wind however strong you build them.

speaker: gauge
text: How does a swinging ball help?

speaker: fitz
text: As the tower leans, the ball swings the other way. Dampers turn that motion into heat. The tower still sways, just less, so people inside feel it less.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
